title: Notice of Intent to Award Sole Source Contract to Aircraft Ducting Repair Inc for Aircraft Duct Repair
agency_path: DEPT OF DEFENSE.DEPT OF THE ARMY.NATIONAL GUARD BUREAU.JFHQ USPFO SD.USPFO SD PROCUREMENT.W7N0 USPFO ACTIVITY SDANG 114
detail_text: This notice is for informational purposes only. The 114th Fighter Wing Contracting Office, Joe foss Field, SD intends to award a sole source contract to Aircraft Ducting Repair, Inc. for the repair of aircraft ducts. Please note that this is not a request for competitive quotes. However, all interested parties who belive they can meet the requirement are invited to submit in writing information describing their ability to provide the service listed above. A determination by the Government to compete this requirement based on response to this notice is soley within the discresion of the Government. Information received will be considered soley for the purpose of determining whether to conduct a competitive procurement.
